verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel publishes public web pages on founder visa pathways, including a Canadian Federal Start-up Visa program page, an InAGrad/J-1 incubator explainer for student entrepreneurs, and attached key visa provisions, plus regularly updated blogs. These pages are not shown to be gated, but the evidence shows only brief snippets, so their depth is unproven. Missing for 10: evidence of detailed startup-visa criteria breakdowns, step-by-step process explainers, real founder case examples, explicit confirmation the materials are ungated, and independent corroboration of the guides' depth.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider publishes substantial free guides on startup visas — criteria breakdowns, process explainers, real examples — open to anyone, not gated lead bait
